contact.title: Contact Us
contact.intro: The Wira team is here to help. Pick whichever channel suits you:

terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.s1_body: By downloading, installing and using the Wira application (the "App"), you confirm that you have read, understood and agreed to these Terms & Conditions. This document forms a binding agreement between you and Wira.
terms.s2_body: Wira provides a platform that connects you with independent service providers — driver partners, merchant partners and service partners — for transport, food delivery, parcel delivery and other services.
terms.s3_body: You need an account to use the App. You are responsible for keeping your account details, including your password, confidential. Everything done through your account is your responsibility.
terms.s4_body: Payment is made in cash directly to the partner, or by QRIS for certain services. QRIS payments are verified by the Wira admin before the order is passed to the partner.
terms.s5_body: Wira is not liable for direct or indirect losses arising from your use of, or inability to use, our services, including but not limited to delivery delays or the conduct of a partner.
terms.s6_body: WiraAsuh babysitters help look after children at the location you choose; parents or guardians remain fully responsible for their children. You must give accurate health, allergy and emergency-contact information and stay reachable during the session. The babysitter gives no medicine without written instructions, does not take children off the premises without permission in the app, and may end a session if the child's or the babysitter's safety is at risk. Payment is in cash after the session; cancellation is free up to 2 hours before the start.

refund.title: Refund Policy
refund.s1_body: Wira is committed to keeping your payments safe. Refunds for QRIS payments follow the terms below and are transferred by the Wira admin to your bank account or e-wallet.
refund.s2_item_1: Before a partner accepts your order, you can cancel at any time. QRIS payments are refunded in full by the Wira admin to your account, usually within 24 hours.
refund.s2_item_2: WiraRide and WiraSend: once a driver accepts, you can cancel free of charge within the first 3 minutes. After that, cancelling opens again if you have not been picked up 20 minutes after the order was accepted. Once you are picked up, the order cannot be cancelled.
refund.s2_item_3: WiraFood: you can cancel while the restaurant has not accepted the order, or within 3 minutes after it does. Once the restaurant starts cooking, contact the Help Center.
refund.s2_item_4: WiraService, WiraPool and WiraAsuh: free cancellation until 2 hours before the scheduled time. If the partner is more than 1 hour late, free cancellation opens again. Once the work has started, the order cannot be cancelled.
refund.s2_item_5: WiraVilla: cancel at least 3 days before check-in for a full refund. Less than 3 days before check-in, 50% is refunded. From the check-in day, the booking cannot be cancelled.
refund.s2_item_6: If a partner declines or cancels your order, you get your payment back in full.
refund.s2_item_7: Wira does not charge cancellation fees. Cash orders involve no refund because nothing has been paid yet.
refund.s3_body: If you paid by QRIS but the order was not passed on, or a system error occurred, contact us through Contact Us within 7×24 hours. We review it within one to three working days.
refund.s4_body: Refunds are transferred to a bank account or e-wallet in the name of the person who placed the order. The Wira admin will contact you for the account number.
